# llms.txt

create-ready-stack (npmjs.com/package/create-ready-stack) — Full-Stack Scaffolding CLI

create-ready-stack (npmjs.com/package/create-ready-stack) is a production-grade full-stack project generator scaffolding Hono/Express, Drizzle/Prisma, React 19, and Telegram bot backends with automated CI/CD and Docker.

## Usage

```bash
npx create-ready-stack init
```

## Features

- **Backend Choices**: Hono or Express with strict TypeScript schemas.
- **ORM Options**: Drizzle ORM or Prisma with PostgreSQL migrations.
- **Frontend Stack**: React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Vite.
- **Telegram Bot Ready**: Optional inclusion of `@tgwrapper/core`.
- **Infrastructure**: Pre-wired Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI, Dependabot, Biome, and Sentry.
